_comment: CI-only typecheck config (the test.yml typecheck step). The repo has no package.json and no runtime dependencies - CI installs typescript + @types/node ephemerally (npm install --no-save) to typecheck cadence-core/bin. checkJs:true is what makes a file checked: every .mjs under include is checked whether or not it carries an @ts-check pragma, so a pragma documents intent and switches nothing on - measured 2026-08-14, 48 of the 49 non-test files carry one and review-provider.mjs, the network seam, carries none and is checked anyway. The test suite stays excluded because including it costs 75 errors across 13 test files, 3 of which carry 45 of them (repo tsc 7.0.2, measured 2026-08-14); the accepted cost is that a test asserting only over properties that still exist keeps passing after the shape underneath it changes, a drift class self-verify structurally cannot see. strict stays off: the checks exist to catch real drift (bad imports, wrong shapes), not to force annotation ceremony onto zero-dep scripts.
